title: Fit the picture
lockedHint: Drag the box to choose the part to use; it is scaled to {width}×{height} and put in.
problemEmpty: The file is empty (0 bytes). Choose another one
problemSvg: SVG is not supported yet. Export it as PNG and upload that
problemNotImage: This file is not a picture. Choose a PNG, JPG, WebP, DDS or TGA
problemBroken: The picture is damaged and cannot be read
errSourceChanged: This picture's source was just updated and the automatic retry failed too. Close this and open it again
errNotReplaceable: This element cannot be replaced yet
errServer: The program had a problem; the picture was not saved.
errTooLarge: The picture is larger than 10 MB. Choose a smaller one
errRefused: The picture was not saved. Try another picture
replaced: Replaced {sprite}; it goes into the export
framesHint: This picture has {frames} frames; every frame uses this part.
distorted: It may look distorted this way: {reason}.
distortStretched: its shape differs from the slot's, so it is stretched
distortUpscaled: the part is smaller than the slot, so it is blurred when enlarged
retouchCost: No AI: the part is fitted whole into the slot's shape, scaled with high quality and lightly sharpened; content and transparency stay as they are.
retouchFailed: The conversion did not work. The original picture is still here and can be used as it is.
